metrics.name: Age of work waiting for review
metrics.numerator: cutoff_utc minus ready_for_review_utc for each still-open review item
metrics.denominator: number of eligible open review items; show item ages and count rather than dividing elapsed times by all started work
metrics.window: Snapshot at the declared cutoff; include blocked review items with reason
metrics.source: Versioned work board or review-request event history
metrics.missingness: Missing ready time is UNKNOWN; report known-time coverage and excluded IDs. With no open items, count is zero and age is NOT_APPLICABLE.
metrics.decision: Pause new implementation starts, help the oldest item, or change staffing/priority under its owner.
metrics.limit: Clock age is not active reviewer effort and does not establish the cause of delay.

metrics.name: Pull-request cycle time
metrics.unit: elapsed hours per merged pull request
metrics.numerator: merged_at minus opened_at for each PR merged in the interval
metrics.denominator: eligible merged PR count; show individual observations or declared distribution summary
metrics.window: Merge-event cohort within the declared interval, with open-age and closed-unmerged counts alongside
metrics.source: Repository PR event history and source revision
metrics.missingness: Missing events are UNKNOWN; report event coverage. No merged PRs means an undefined distribution, not zero-duration delivery.
metrics.decision: Investigate a review or integration delay while examining defect and effort signals together.
metrics.limit: Different task mixes, open work and excluded abandoned PRs can bias a comparison; this is not DORA commit-to-production lead time.

metrics.name: Human review effort per accepted work item
metrics.numerator: Recorded review effort for all attempts in the declared work cohort, including rejected/stale/abandoned work
metrics.denominator: distinct logical items with an applicable accepted owner record at cutoff
metrics.window: A fixed admitted-work cohort and cutoff; report pending/rejected items beside accepted count
metrics.source: Pseudonymous effort intervals plus versioned owner dispositions and artifact links
metrics.missingness: Any missing required effort or acceptance evidence makes the complete-cohort ratio UNKNOWN; show known subtotal and coverage. Known zero accepted items gives UNDEFINED.
metrics.decision: Improve the review preparation or verification path before adding generation capacity.
metrics.limit: Self-reported effort remains self-report; elapsed process time cannot fill the field, and one person interval is counted once.

metrics.name: Confirmed escaped defects per 100 eligible deployed changes
metrics.numerator: Confirmed post-release defects discovered within each eligible change's predeclared follow-up window and attributed to that change cohort under the stated review rule; declare how multi-change defects are counted.
metrics.denominator: deployed changes with completed, equally defined follow-up windows
metrics.window: Declare follow-up duration before collection; retain immature changes and unlinked incidents separately
metrics.source: Incident/defect records joined to deployment and review records
metrics.missingness: Missing attribution or follow-up is UNKNOWN, not no defects; show investigated and pending cases. No deployments in the local lab means NOT_APPLICABLE.
metrics.decision: Narrow rollout or improve a missed control when corroborated by the incident evidence.
metrics.limit: A ratio can exceed one defect per change; correlation does not identify an AI cause and zero observed defects is not zero residual risk.
metrics.calculation: 100 * confirmed in-window attributed defects / eligible changes with completed follow-up; undefined for a known zero denominator.

metrics.name: Incorrect-review-finding share
metrics.numerator: findings that the nominated technical reviewer judged incorrect under the declared criteria
metrics.denominator: all findings adjudicated in the chosen cohort; report untriaged count separately
metrics.window: Fixed reviewer/tool/version and task cohort at cutoff
metrics.source: Finding, disposition, rationale, reviewer and exact candidate references
metrics.missingness: No adjudicated findings means UNDEFINED; untriaged or unresolved cases are not correct findings. Report adjudication coverage.
metrics.decision: Tune, narrow, suspend or retire a noisy reviewer while retaining useful findings.
metrics.limit: Adjudication can itself be wrong; a high precision on a selected triaged subset does not establish recall or independence.
metrics.calculation: 100 * adjudicated incorrect findings / all adjudicated findings; undefined for a known zero denominator.

metrics.name: Complete cost per accepted outcome
metrics.unit: declared currency per distinct accepted item
metrics.numerator: All in-scope effort valuation, service charges, allocated setup/infrastructure and unsuccessful attempts without overlap
metrics.denominator: same accepted-item rule and cutoff as M03
metrics.window: Same fixed cohort and reporting cutoff; declare allocation and currency rules
metrics.source: Effort ledger, rate assumptions, attributable invoices/usage evidence, allocation record and owner decisions
metrics.missingness: Unknown required costs or acceptance make the complete ratio UNKNOWN; zero known accepted denominator is UNDEFINED. Preserve partial subtotal and coverage.
metrics.decision: Continue a bounded pilot, change the workflow or stop under the previously declared rule.
metrics.limit: A cost using assumed rates or vendor telemetry estimates is modeled/estimated at those inputs; it is not silently relabeled paid expenditure or causal savings.

source_note: Original operational definitions for this book. Chapter 14 distinguishes these from DORA delivery metrics; no empirical benefit is established by collecting them.
